blocks.size_first: SIZE FIRST: the pouch is a small single-serve 1 fl oz (30 mL) pouch, about 6.5 cm wide and 15 cm tall: a little shorter than an adult hand from wrist crease to fingertip, about one and a half times as tall as a coffee mug, never bigger than the hand holding it. It is flat and thin like a juice pouch, never a bottle, never a box.
blocks.pouch_block: The product is the REAL Youtheory B12B6 Liquid pouch in the reference images: a soft glossy WHITE foil pouch shaped like a flat bottle (wide flat body with slightly crinkled edges, rounded shoulders narrowing to a short neck). Front print, top to bottom, exactly as the close-ups: a small dark grey round 'youtheory' leaf mark with a tiny orange leaf inside and the word 'youtheory' in thin dark grey lowercase; a large circle made of round dots in shades of magenta and deep raspberry pink; 'B12B6' in large magenta serif with small '12' and '6' beside capital 'B's; 'liquid' in large grey serif lowercase directly below it; nothing to the right of 'B12B6'; two thin grey lines around 'promotes brain health*' in grey italic; 'helps support energy production*' in grey italic; a magenta rounded bar with white bold text 'raspberry flavor'; '1 fl oz (30 ml)' at the left and 'dietary supplement' in grey italic at the right; a small boxed disclaimer at the bottom. The print matches the references letter for letter and colour for colour, stays flat on the pouch and inside its edges; no other marks, no extra text, no added symbols.
blocks.straw_block: STRAW, every frame: the pouch's small magenta screw cap at the top of the neck has been twisted off and is not on the pouch; the short magenta spout is open and ONE plain white paper straw stands upright in the spout, about 10 cm above the pouch, straight and unbent. The straw is always there and never moves out of the pouch.
blocks.box_block: The carton is the REAL Youtheory display box in images 5 and 6, matching them letter for letter and colour for colour: a white carton about as tall as the pouches, whose front panel is torn away along a diagonal perforated line (high at the right, low at the left), so the white pouches with magenta caps show above the tear. Below the tear the front reads, exactly as image 6: 'B6' in large magenta serif (the 'B12' was torn away with the top), 'liquid' in grey serif lowercase beneath it, then three lines each starting with a small magenta plus sign: 'great tasting & ready to drink', 'promotes brain health*', '1,000 mcg of B12 per serving' with '1,000 mcg' in magenta and the rest grey; a splash of pale pink liquid with red raspberries at the lower left; four small grey round icons in a row; a deep raspberry band along the bottom edge with small white text, 'dietary supplement' at the right.
blocks.hand_block: ONLY one hand enters from the frame edge: Grace's hand exactly as in the hand reference sheet: medium-brown skin, slim fingers, natural pink nails with crisp white French tips; on the wrist a FLAT gold bracelet of rectangular links like a watch band (NO watch face) and a thin gold chain with small pearls and a gold leaf charm; rings exactly as in the sheet: a silver crown-shaped stack ring, a thin gold solitaire ring and a blue silicone band. Whole wrist visible, a little forearm may show. Fingers GRIP the pouch body below the shoulders (thumb on the front edge, fingers curled behind) and never cover the B12B6 wordmark; nothing rests loose on the palm. Five fingers, natural knuckles and skin texture.
blocks.no_hand: No hands, no fingers, no arms, no people anywhere in the frame at any time, nothing entering at any edge.
blocks.scene_suffix: Vertical 9:16 phone photo, soft bright natural daylight from a window, clean neutral white balance (no yellow, no golden, no dark or moody look), sharp focus on the pouch, realistic textures. The room matches the room reference photo. Every other item is plain and unbranded: no brand names or logos on anything except the real Youtheory print. No text, no captions, no watermark, no phone UI.
blocks.omni_head: Recreate image 1 exactly as the first frame: keep its room, light, framing{hand} and the white paper straw standing in the pouch exactly. Image 2 is the real logo and magenta dot circle, image 3 the real 'B12B6 liquid' wordmark, claim lines and 'raspberry flavor' bar: they stay on the pouch the whole clip and match images 2 and 3 letter for letter and colour for colour. Image 4 is the product sheet: keep this exact pouch shape, small size and colours, no added marks, no extra text. The straw stays upright in the pouch in every frame.
blocks.omni_tail: Vertical 9:16 phone footage, bright neutral daylight that never changes, realistic skin and foil. No music, no voice, no captions, no on-screen text.

shots.words: A pouch a day keeps laziness away.
shots.still: Bedroom nightstand from the room photo (white drawers, wooden top, snake plant in a pink pot, stained-glass lamp), morning light, the bed with rumpled sheets at the left edge. One pouch stands upright on the nightstand top in the centre of the frame, front label facing the lens; the hand has just entered from the right edge and grips the pouch body.
shots.motion: The hand keeps one grip and lifts the pouch straight up about 10 cm toward the lens, label facing the camera the whole time; the pouch never turns or flips. Camera: slow push-in.

shots.words: Because sometimes, you don't need more motivation.
shots.still: Low close-up on the same nightstand top: the pouch stands upright at the right third, front label facing the lens, beside a plain round white alarm clock with no numbers and a small stack of two closed plain books; the snake plant and lamp soft in the background.
shots.motion: Nothing in the scene moves. Camera: slow dolly in toward the pouch with a slight drift left to right.

shots.words: Your body may need B vitamins!
shots.still: Bright kitchen from the room photo (grey counter, window with plants, sage bowl), counter soft behind: the hand holds one pouch upright at chest height in the centre of the frame, front label facing the lens, B12B6 large and sharp.
shots.motion: The hand keeps one grip and gives the pouch two gentle little shakes up and down; the pouch never turns or flips. Camera: steady, tiny push-in.

shots.still: Same kitchen counter, close and low: the pouch stands upright on the counter, front label facing the lens, next to a small sage-green bowl heaped with fresh red raspberries; a few raspberries lie loose on the counter in front; the window and plants soft behind.
shots.motion: Nothing in the scene moves. Camera: slow arc a little to the right around the pouch and bowl, ending with the label still facing the lens.

shots.words: B6 and B12 pouch makes it easy.
shots.still: Same kitchen, the raspberry bowl soft at the lower left: the hand holds one pouch upright just below the top edge of the frame, front label facing the lens, as if about to sip from the straw.
shots.motion: The hand keeps one grip and lifts the pouch slowly toward the top edge of the frame, as if bringing the straw to someone's lips just out of frame; the pouch stays upright, never turns or flips, and the straw tip leaves the frame first. Camera: steady.

shots.words: There are 12 in a box, so I'd stock up on a few!
shots.still: Same kitchen counter: the open display carton full of pouches stands on the counter at the left of centre, its front print facing the lens; at the right the hand holds the one pouch with the straw upright next to the carton, label facing the lens, about to set it down.
shots.motion: The hand keeps one grip and sets the straw pouch down on the counter beside the carton, then lets go and leaves the frame at the right edge. The carton never moves and its print never changes. Camera: slow push-in.

shots.words: B6 and B12 support normal energy metabolism,
shots.still: Entryway from the room photo (wood wall panel with a jacket on a hook, padded bench, front door, white sneakers on the floor): the pouch stands upright on the bench cushion next to a rolled pale-green yoga mat and a plain canvas tote bag, front label facing the lens.
shots.motion: Nothing in the scene moves. Camera: slow dolly in from a little higher, ending level with the pouch.

shots.words: and B12 supports normal nervous system function.
shots.still: Home office from the room photo (desk by a window, laptop, many green plants, hanging vines): the pouch stands upright on the desk in front of the laptop, front label facing the lens, beside an open notebook with blank pages and a pen.
shots.motion: Nothing in the scene moves. Camera: slow push-in with a slight drift left; the plants stay soft behind.

shots.words: Tap the orange cart and grab yours while they're in stock!
shots.still: Same home office, the desk and plants soft behind: the hand holds one pouch upright toward the lens in the centre of the frame, front label facing the camera, filling about a third of the frame height.
shots.motion: The hand keeps one grip and holds the pouch steady toward the lens with a tiny tilt of a few degrees; the pouch never turns or flips. Camera: slow push-in.
